title: From ADPCM to AI: The Past, Present and Future of Game Audio Codecs

s1.description: Who is speaking, why this talk, and Titanfall as an example of a codec tradeoff

s2.description: Raw PCM and its cost, codec basics, what a codec setting affects, the path of a voice, how a perceptual codec works, and the problems codecs solve in games: samples, memory, voice chat, streaming and hardware

s3.description: The past: a short history of game audio codecs, then ADPCM and MP3

s4.description: The modern toolbox: Opus, Vorbis, AAC, XMA, ATRAC9 and a decision framework

s5.description: The frontier: APAC, QOA, neural audio codecs and Opus 1.6, honestly assessed
